motion.name: ease-arrive
motion.purpose: Every landing entrance, the screenshot settle, details open, and the header nav underline.

motion.name: arrive
motion.value: opacity and transform 600ms ease-arrive; from translateY(14px)
motion.purpose: A point's children arrive when the light reaches its node, once.

motion.name: arrive-stagger
motion.purpose: Delays for the second, third, and remaining children of a block, read top to bottom.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: transform 750ms ease-arrive, opacity 300ms; from translateY(105%) under clip-path inset(0 -0.1em -0.25em -0.1em)

motion.name: reduced-fade

motion.purpose: Motion off or prefers-reduced-motion: a short fade only.

motion.name: node-flare
motion.value: fill 0.4s ease, r 0.4s ease, stroke-width 0.6s ease

motion.name: shot-in

motion.name: details-open
motion.value: height and opacity 250ms ease-arrive (interpolate-size: allow-keywords); caret rotate 0.2s ease

narrative.overview:
The ground is a clean, full-bleed aerial of Miami at dusk, fixed behind everything and never framed. Detailed text points sit on it in a zig-zag down the page, and a single glowing line of light joins them, its bright head running ahead of the reader to the next point. The light is the only thing drawn on the footage; the film is not annotated, ringed, boxed, or tinted.

Type does the structural work that panels would do elsewhere. A high-contrast Bodoni Moda display carries names and headlines like title cards; Archivo carries every reading line and action. Legibility comes from a feathered dusk falloff that sits behind each text block with no readable edge, plus a soft text halo, so the film stays continuous right up to the letters.

Motion is tied to the light: a point's text arrives when the light reaches its node, once, and stays. With motion off the film shows one still per point, the light is fully drawn, and text only fades.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed dusk footage as the only ground; no panels, cards, glass, rings, or red.
One blue (accent) for the light, its nodes, focus rings, links, and Email me.
Bodoni Moda display over Archivo text, ivory-white on dusk.
Points placed on a 12-column grid in a zig-zag, each a 560px reading block.
Text arrives with the light; reduced motion gets a fade only.
The AI disclosure is always on screen with the film.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Flight Blue and its core belong to the light and to the things the light points at (Email me, links in focus, the current place). No second accent, and never red.

rules.name: The Feathered Falloff Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on a shape with an edge. Its backing is a horizontal dusk gradient (0 to 66% to 66% to 0) masked by a 140px vertical feather; on phones it collapses to a flat 60% dusk.

rules.name: The Title Card Rule
rules.body: The name and each headline rise from behind their own baseline (clipped, translateY 105% to 0 over 750ms); no other type moves that way.

rules.name: The Plain Words Rule
rules.body: No em dashes in copy. Date ranges and separators read as words ("October 2022 to Present"); the landing converts dashes with `plain()`.

rules.name: The Only Ink Is Light Rule
rules.body: Nothing is drawn on the film except the light path: its dim route, glow, core, nodes, and head. No rings, callouts, markup, panels, cards, or glass over the footage.

rules.name: The Veil Is Not a Band Rule
rules.body: The top veil is an opaque dusk bar exactly the header's height plus a 24px fade; the bottom veil is only a corner patch (min(420px, 100%) by 64px) behind the disclosure, full-width 64px fade on phones. The film is never framed in bands.

dos: Do keep the film full-bleed, fixed, and clean, with dusk (#0b0d18) behind it.
Do put every text block on the feathered falloff with a 140px feather and no visible edge.
Do reserve Flight Blue for the light, nodes, focus, the current place, and Email me.
Do set names and headlines in Bodoni Moda 500 and everything else in Archivo.
Do keep reading blocks to 560px on the 12-column grid, separated by 40svh of open film (28svh on phones).
Do place exit nodes out in the film by clamp(140px, 18vw, 320px) so the light crosses the footage.
Do let text arrive with the light on ease-arrive, and fall back to a 200ms fade for reduced motion.
Do keep the AI disclosure visible whenever the film is on screen.
Do write date ranges and separators as words.
donts: Don't draw anything on the film but the light: no rings, markup, callouts, or redlines.
Don't put text in panels, cards, or glass, and don't add box shadows.
Don't introduce red or a second accent color.
Don't frame the film in solid bands top and bottom; only the header bar and the disclosure patch are veiled.
Don't use em dashes in copy.
Don't hide or shrink away the AI disclosure.
Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headlines on new points; the headline leads.
